text: M&A Advisory Services: professional consulting services for mergers, acquisitions, and corporate restructuring; M&A advisory; merger and acquisition advisory; corporate advisory; deal advisory; transaction advisory; M&A consultant; merger advisory services; acquisition advisory; corporate restructuring advisory
reasons: GeM categories are product-focused (e.g., IT, construction) and rarely contain specific professional consulting services like M&A advisory; these bids are typically issued via separate RFPs or specialized consultancy portals rather than standard GeM product categories.
